name: 灭火器配置计算（应急救援）

map.根据保护面积、火灾类型和危险等级，按常用设计参数估算灭火器的配置数量。: Estimate the number of fire extinguishers required from the protection area, fire class and hazard level using common design parameters.
map.📚 深度解析：灭火器配置计算（应急救援）: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Fire Extinguisher Configuration Calculation (Emergency Rescue)
map.新建车间按 GB 50140 估算所需灭火级别与具数，作为采购与布置清单的依据。: For a new workshop, estimate the required extinguishing rating and number of units per GB 50140 as the basis for the purchase and layout list.
map.场所改变火灾危险等级（如办公室改为仓储）后，复核原有配置是否仍然达标。: After a premises changes fire hazard level (such as office to storage), recheck whether the existing configuration still complies.
map.消防安全检查时按实际保护面积快速核对配置数量与设置点数是否满足最低要求。: During a fire safety inspection, quickly verify from the actual protection area whether the number of units and setting points meets the minimum requirements.
map.按可燃物数量、火灾蔓延速度与扑救难度分为轻、中、严重三级。同一建筑的不同区域可分: They are divided into light, ordinary and high hazard by the amount of combustibles, fire spread rate and difficulty of suppression. Different areas of the same building may be graded separately (for example ordinary hazard for offices, high hazard for storage), and each should be calculated at its own worst case and then summed.
map.Q = K·S/U（K 取 1.0，未设室内消火栓与灭火系统；S 为保护面积，U: Q = K·S/U (K = 1.0, no indoor hydrants or suppression system; S = protected area, U = max area per rating unit, GB 50140-2005 §6.2.1); units from 4 kg ABC dry powder (2A/55B): N = max(2, ⌈Q ÷ unit rating⌉); setting points = max(1, ⌊N ÷ 2⌋) (≤5 units per point, §6.1)
map.本页按 GB 50140-2005 表 6.2.1 取 U 值：A 类轻/中/严: This page uses the U values in GB 50140-2005 Table 6.2.1: 100/75/50 m²/A for Class A light/ordinary/high hazard and 1.5/1.0/0.5 m²/B for Classes B and C (Class C is rated with Class B ratings). Results are preliminary estimates; formal design must be reviewed by a certified fire-protection designer and checked against the maximum travel distances in Table 5.2.1.
map.依据 GB 50140-2005：单位灭火级别最大保护面积 U 见表 6.2.1: Per GB 50140-2005: the max area per rating unit U is given in Table 6.2.1 (Class A light/ordinary/high 100/75/50 m²/A; Classes B/C 1.5/1.0/0.5 m²/B); minimum required rating Q = K·S/U with K = 1.0 (no indoor hydrants or suppression system); units are estimated from 4 kg ABC dry powder (2A/55B), with at least 2 units per calculation unit and no more than 5 units per setting point (§6.1).
map.A 类轻/中/严重 100/75/50 m²/A；B、C 类 1.5/1.0/0: Class A 100/75/50 m²/A; Classes B/C 1.5/1.0/0.5 m²/B
map.Q = K·S/U；K 取 1.0（未设室内消火栓与灭火系统）: Q = K·S/U; K = 1.0 (no indoor hydrant or suppression system)
map.4kg ABC 干粉约 2A/55B（以铭牌为准）；具数 = ⌈Q ÷ 单具级别: 4 kg ABC dry powder ≈ 2A/55B (per nameplate); units = ⌈Q ÷ unit rating⌉
map.A 类手提式 20m（轻/中）、15m（严重）；B、C 类 15/12/9m: Class A portable 20 m (light/ordinary), 15 m (high); Classes B/C 15/12/9 m
map.每个计算单元不少于 2 具；每个设置点不宜多于 5 具: ≥2 units per calculation unit; ≤5 units per setting point
map.按铭牌灭火级别计入，无统一 ×2.5 折算: Counted by nameplate rating; no universal 2.5× conversion
map.A 类轻危险级 300 m² 场所配置核算: Configuration check for a 300 m² Class A light-hazard premises
map.按默认参数（A 类火灾、轻危险级、保护面积 300 m²）：U=100 m²/A: With default parameters (Class A fire, light hazard, protected area 300 m²): U = 100 m²/A, so Q = K·S/U = 3A; with a 4 kg ABC dry powder unit rated 2A, ⌈3/2⌉ = 2 units (and at least 2 per calculation unit), needing about 1 setting point at 2 units per point. Each point should have no more than 5 units, and the walking distance from any point to the nearest setting point must meet Table 5.2.1 (Class A portable 20 m, high hazard 15 m).
map.为什么每个计算单元最少要配 2 具？: Why at least 2 units per calculation unit?
map.GB 50140-2005 §6.1 规定一个计算单元内配置的灭火器数量不得少于: GB 50140-2005 §6.1 requires at least 2 extinguishers per calculation unit and no more than 5 per setting point, so a backup remains if one fails, loses pressure or is cut off by fire, while avoiding over-concentration at a single point.
